crossRefs.keyword: everlasting kingdom. Heb. kingdom of all ages

translations.web: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. Yahweh is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.
translations.bsb: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and Your dominion endures through all generations. The LORD is faithful in all His words and kind in all His actions.
translations.kjv: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
translations.asv: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, And thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
